title: Maintenance.
officialText:
Mechanical systems, both existing and new, and parts thereof shall be maintained in proper operating condition
in accordance with the original design and in a safe and sanitary condition. Devices or safeguards that are required by this code shall
be maintained in compliance with the applicable provisions under which they were installed.
